node.title: PMA source chart embeds in the all-pair paving-basis compiler
node.statement: After factoring the retained background, the PMA auxiliary list is a degree-<kappa interpolation list with threshold kappa+sigma. Pinned interpolation bases give sum_Q binom(a(Q),kappa)<=binom(|T|,kappa), and one added locator realizes every object, including repeated slopes, in the transverse weighted-RS chart of upstream PR #764.
